title: Dissolution of the Soviet Union
summary: In December 1991 the leaders of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus signed accords on 8 December to end the USSR and form the Commonwealth of Independent States. On 25 December Mikhail Gorbachev resigned as Soviet president, and the Soviet flag was lowered over the Kremlin for the last time, replaced by the Russian tricolor.

uncertainty.note: Start is the signing of the Belovezhie accords; end is Gorbachev's resignation and the lowering of the flag. The sources used do not give a date for the formal legal end of the USSR, so none is claimed.

as_recorded.value: December 25, 1991 (Gorbachev resigned; Soviet flag lowered for the last time)

where.historical_name: Kremlin, Moscow, capital of the Soviet Union (and of the Russian republic) in December 1991

importance.justification: The end of a superpower and of the Cold War order.
